hints.site_url: Where the site is served from, with no trailing slash. Used for every canonical link and every share-card address. Use http://localhost:8080 while developing.
hints.site_tagline: Added to a page title that would otherwise be too short to read in a search result.
hints.site_name: Shown in the header, in every page title and as the studio's name in search results.
hints.twitter_handle: Without the @. Credits the studio when someone shares a page.
hints.org_logo: The studio's mark. Used in search results and as the share picture when a page has none of its own.
hints.default_og_image: The picture shown when a page with no image of its own is shared. 1200x630.
hints.org_sameas_json: The studio's profiles elsewhere: itch.io, Steam, social accounts. Search engines use them to tie the site to those accounts.
hints.org_legal_name: The registered name, if it differs from the site name. Leave blank if they are the same.
hints.org_description: One or two sentences on what the studio is. Appears in search results, and fills out any page description too short on its own.
hints.org_email: The address a player or a journalist should write to. Published in the studio's structured data.
hints.org_founding_date: YYYY-MM-DD. Only for the studio's structured data.
hints.org_founding_location: A city or a country. Only for the studio's structured data.
hints.hero_cta_link: Where the homepage button goes. A path on this site (/games) or a full address elsewhere.
